scope: Additive design policy; not official skill revision

VISUAL_COMPARISON.composition: simultaneous evidence panels; size by aspect ratio
VISUAL_COMPARISON.guard: Keep labels and source rights; do not force false contrast

MEMORY_FOCUS.guard: Hide cue at open questions; no answer preview

CHALLENGE_BOARD.composition: task ticket, destinations, progress and feedback
CHALLENGE_BOARD.guard: No countdown requirement; preserve attempts and repair states

TECHNOLOGY_LAB.composition: input, state, mechanism, output; one main diagram
TECHNOLOGY_LAB.guard: Prediction before action; accurate states and exceptions

deterministic: unchanged interaction logic or approved diff
explicit_limits: Do not claim upstream software executed
Do not claim full learner or accessibility validation from screenshots
Do not send private checkpoint or teacher answers to public CI
validation.rerun: only impacted scene and dependent regressions
validation.fallback: one batched human request only when required
